camel_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost CreateOperationTicket --region cn-hangzhou --ProtocolName SSH --InstanceId 'bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000' --ApproveComment Comment --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --AssetAccountName root --AssetId 2
description_en: Creates an O&M request. When an administrator enables O&M approval in control policies, O&M engineers must create an O&M request and obtain administrator approval before performing O&M operations
description_zh: 管理员配置控制策略时开启了运维审批时，运维人员需要先创建运维申请且管理员审批通过后才能进行运维
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost create-operation-ticket --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --asset-id 2 --protocol-name SSH --asset-account-name root --approve-comment Comment --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateOperationTicket

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the bastion host.
You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host.
For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the asset for which you want to request O&M access.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758856.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758857.html operation to query this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
需要申请运维的资产ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758856.html和https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758857.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: asset_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the protocol for which you want to request O&M access. Valid values:
SSH
RDP
MySQL
PostgreSQL
Oracle
SQLServer
parameters.help_zh:
指定要申请运维的协议名称。取值：
SSH
RDP
MySQL
PostgreSQL
Oracle
SQLServer
parameters.name: protocol_name

parameters.help_en: The logon name of the asset account for which you want to request O&M access
parameters.help_zh: 指定要申请运维的资产账户登录名
parameters.name: asset_account_name

parameters.help_en:
The number of logon times allowed. Valid values:
true: Only one logon is allowed within the validity period.
false: Unlimited logons are allowed within the validity period
parameters.help_zh:
申请登录次数。取值：
true：在有效期内仅登录一次。
false：在有效期内不限制登录次数
parameters.name: is_one_time_effect

parameters.help_en: The start time of the validity period for the logon request. Unit: seconds. The value is a UNIX timestamp
parameters.help_zh: 申请登录的有效期开始时间。（秒，时间戳格式）
parameters.name: effect_start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time of the validity period for the logon request. Unit: seconds. The value is a UNIX timestamp.
The end time of the validity period must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
申请登录的有效期结束时间。（秒，时间戳格式）
申请登录的有效期结束时间需要晚于申请登录的有效期开始时间
parameters.name: effect_end_time

OperationTicketId.description_en: The ID of the O&M request
